name: Bungalows at The Boca Raton
positioning: Apartment-style two-bedroom suites with a private gated pool, tucked in a serene corner of The Boca Raton resort
best_for: Families and groups wanting two-bedroom suites with a full kitchen

facts.text: Bungalows is tucked in a serene corner of The Boca Raton.
Bungalows' apartment-style accommodations are ideal for long-term stays.
Bungalows has a private, gated entrance.
Guests have access to a dedicated concierge team.
Complimentary continental breakfast and afternoon snacks are served at Bungalows Reception.
Bungalows has a private fitness room.
Guests can use a fleet of bicycles and the water taxi service.
Guests receive a beach bag and flip flops.
Bath amenities are by Molton Brown.
Parking is complimentary, and a lounge room is available for early arrival and late departure guests.

highlights.text: Bungalows has a private gated pool.
The suites have two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a full kitchen, a living room and a dining area, with terraces or balconies.
Conde Nast Traveler describes the Bungalows as apartment-style options with private entrances and muted design aesthetics.
Guests get access to the private amenities of The Boca Raton Club.

considerations.text: Bungalows is dog-friendly only for dogs up to 35 pounds.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
